description: Machine-readable registry of the public SDK surface. Source of truth for exports is src/codeflare_sdk/__init__.py.

codeflare.notes: Single entrypoint. JobOptions is a TypedDict describing the shared keyword arguments of the cf.jobs.create()/submit() overloads; it carries no runtime behaviour.

auth.notes: AuthConfig and get_k8s_client are re-exported from kube-authkit and are the current authentication interface; both are also available at the package root. set_api_client is re-exported at the package root but deprecated as of v0.40.0 (RHOAIENG-98947) — use Codeflare(config=SDKConfig(auth=...)), which scopes the client instead of setting a process-wide global. Authentication, KubeConfiguration, TokenAuthentication and KubeConfigFileAuthentication were removed in v0.40.0 after deprecation in v0.39.x; codeflare_sdk.__getattr__ raises an ImportError naming the replacement. ManagedClusterConfig (tech preview) was removed the same way.

utils.notes: get_current_namespace is exported via common.utils; generate_cert and copy_demo_nbs are re-exported at package root.

internal_modules.notes: Ray layers currently import some internal utils submodules directly. Prefer package-level imports from codeflare_sdk or codeflare_sdk.common.utils where possible.
